title_en: From Review Signals to Reliable Launch Decisions
title_zh: 从评论信号到可靠的上市决策
assessment_en: Author-external, same-model-family AI review read the prompt and all 23 PDF pages, independently checked selected figures, and reviewed coverage, claims, disclosure and layout. Award opinion is uncalibrated.
assessment_zh: 作者外、同模型家族AI评阅，完整读原题与23页PDF；独立核查若干数字并评审问题覆盖、结论、披露和版面。奖档意见未校准。
strength_en: Organizes the analysis around review denominators, product composition and historical information, with restrained claims about text prediction and causality.
strength_zh: 以评论分母、产品构成和历史可用信息为分析主线；对文本预测增益和因果边界作克制判断。
limits_en: No sales ground truth, human semantic labels or causal validation; uncalibrated award opinion is not an outcome.
limits_zh: 没有销售真值、真人语义标注或因果效应验证；非校准奖档意见不是结果。
reviewer_identity_zh: c2020_baseline_reviewer；作者外、同模型家族AI评阅，非真人。
